text: @local/dsh-tool-bash-parallel 是一个 DSH 开发工具插件，通过 bundle patch 将 bash_parallel 工具和提示词说明注册到 host plane。它能在一次调用中并发运行多条相互独立的 Bash 命令，限制同时运行数并保留输入顺序汇总 stdout、stderr 和退出状态，也支持为命令指定工作目录与超时。适合需要同时查看多个文件或目录、执行互不依赖的项目查询的 DSH 用户。命令在各自的新 shell 中运行，结果可显示失败和超时信息；代码未要求 API 密钥或外部服务。

@local/dsh-tool-bash-parallel adds bash_parallel to DSH. It runs independent Bash commands concurrently and returns results in order. Set concurrency, working directory, or timeout per command. Useful for examining several files together; no API key or external service is required.
想把几条互不依赖的 Bash 命令放在一次 DSH 调用里并行跑。
查多个目录和文件时，能不能同时执行这些 shell 命令？
让 DSH 一次提交多条独立命令，并按提交顺序返回各自结果。
@local/dsh-tool-bash-parallel 的功能「并行运行命令」：通过 bash_parallel 一次提交多条独立 Bash 命令，可限制并发数并为命令设置工作目录或超时，最后按输入顺序返回每条命令的输出和状态。

@local/dsh-tool-bash-parallel README · Why：The harness overlaps parallel-safe tool calls, but the built-in `bash` tool
declares no `isConcurrencySafe`, so consecutive shell calls serialize.
Exploration work — list this, read those, grep for that — is independent by
nature and is exactly what this tool batches: one model turn, one tool call,
N commands in flight.

@local/dsh-tool-bash-parallel README · Install：From the DeepSeek Harness UI or plugin manager, install from this directory:

```
plugin_manager: install_bundle  target: /path/to/tools
```

Or add it as a linked dependency in the profile's `package.json` and list
`@local/dsh-tool-bash-parallel` under `dsh.profile.bundles`.

@local/dsh-tool-bash-parallel README · Tool：- Each command runs in a fresh shell; commands cannot see each other's
  working directory, environment, or output.
- `workdir` is relative to the session's current directory; `timeoutMs`
  kills the command when it expires.
- Results keep input order. Per-command failures and timeouts are result
  data, never tool errors — check each `[exit code: N]` line.
- A system-prompt section nudges the model to put all independent commands
  of a step into one call instead of a few per call.

@local/dsh-tool-bash-parallel README · Plugin：Registered on the host plane through a single bundle patch
(`cordis.patch.yml`), so every preset and session in the profile sees it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Package | `@local/dsh-tool-bash-parallel` |
| Entry id | `tool-bash-parallel` |
| Injects | `tools`, `shell`, `systemPrompt`, `shellEnv`, `workingDirectory` |
| Caps | 16 commands per call · 10 concurrent · 600 s tool timeout |
